notes:
Mythos 0.2.0

New and improved

- Redesigned Codex with richer dossiers, taxonomy and hierarchy editing, bulk actions, and resource history across Explorations.
- Codex Auto-populate uses the established document-to-taxonomy and lore extraction workflow. The experimental captured-input and layout-review screens are hidden in this release.
- Source Sets organize related documents, revisions, and source metadata for review and export. Improved Exploration comparison and merge previews preserve rich content.
- A persistent Reference panel lets you browse and keep supporting material beside your manuscript, with improved document, Codex, and asset viewing.
- Expanded table editing, including structured tables, cell alignment, borders, shading, and automatic column widths.
- Version History improvements include editable labels and version pins, clearer Source Set capture details, and more readable list and comparison views.
- Reclaim Space previews project storage cleanup and protects retained history. Pending document saves must succeed before cleanup can run.
- Improved AI provider profiles, capability-specific model discovery, local-model compatibility, and diagnostics. Troubleshooting logs are easier to access from Settings.

Fixes and reliability

- Muse conversations are saved with the project, and source citations link back to documents when a matching source is available.
- Muse prompts and AI replies synchronize between connected desktop and iPad chat panels. Update both applications to use this improvement.
- Long-running local-model chats on iPad no longer stop at the old one-minute client timeout.
- Cancel and close now work correctly when comparing identical document versions.
- Improved rich-document save handling when switching documents, table edit persistence, and automatic column-width behavior.
- Fixed outline navigation past collapsed headings, cross-reference heading selection, and reference asset rendering.
- Analytics now fills the available window width on desktop and iPad-sized displays.
- Improved autosave, project switching, conflict recovery, and reconnection handling across connected devices.

This release keeps the established Codex extraction core. The experimental G1-G9 auto-extraction pipeline is not enabled in the normal extraction workflow.
